steps: For the first time in Filanis, you, Alina, and Elis catch your breath. In the meantime, you and Alina expose a noble's slave-trading ring. With no way home in sight, the two of you share your doubts and grow closer...
10:00, The Sixth Month 10th, Outside Filanis Island, Deep in the Forest
How was that, teacher Elis? Did I get the flash spell right?
Perfect. You've gotten so good at the flash spell that even I might not be able to cast it more precisely.
Let's try another spell. How about water creation?==W==
Whoa, that's bright! It's making me tear up.==W== That's one unusual way to create water.
I-I'm sorry! I think I cast the wrong spell.
Let's try an ignition spell.==W== See if you can light this leaf.
I-It caught fire!==W== But only because your flash spell was so powerful that the light reflected off your sword and focused on the leaf!
What's going on? I taught you how to cast spells. Why does everything turn into flash magic?!
I...==W== I don't know.==W== I was picturing water and fire, but it still came out like this. Did I misunderstand your lessons?
Ugh...==W== I might have better luck teaching a tree.
Please don't be mad, Elis.==W== I did figure out a few ...==W== new tricks.==W== Please watch.
I can now infuse my sword strikes with flash magic. It lights up distant targets, even in the dead of night.
I can shape the light into a blade. If I ever lose my weapon, I can keep fighting.
Hm...==W== To be fair, these are pretty good spells.==W== But...==W== They're still flash magic!
You don't lack magical talent, Alina.==W== The Goddess of Magic clearly played a prank and dumped all of yours into flash spells.
Does that mean ...==W== this is the only spell I'll ever learn?
Two or three==W== at most...==W== But you can still develop your flash magic into different forms, like you just did. That should solve quite a few problems.
I've got nothing left to teach you.==W== Go spar with someone for inspiration.==W== I'm heading back to the Wishing Box!==W==
Are you free, ==PLAYER_NAME==?==W== Do you want to practice swordplay for a bit?
Oof...==W== I'll pass today. My arms and lower back are killing me...
Don't press there! It's sore... Ow!
Bear with it.==W== You'll feel better in a minute.
Ugh...==W==How is this supposed to help...==W== Huh? Wait,==W== the soreness is actually fading.
It's my fault for pushing you too hard yesterday.==W== After such strenuous exercise, soaking in a hot bath for so long must have left your muscles exhausted.
Her familiar touch on my shoulders makes me close my eyes.
Maybe surviving that missing persons case together built trust between us.
Maybe it was the victory feast.
Or maybe we are just kindred spirits, each carrying unspoken secrets and wishes...
Before we knew it, the three of us had grown much closer.
Elis taught Alina how to cast spells,
while Alina showed Elis around Filanis, taking her through every corner of the City of Perfection.
After helping Noya with cooking for so long, I picked up a thing or two myself and somehow became the best cook among the Night Watchers.
Alina asked me for cooking tips, and in return, she drilled me in swordplay every day, hopeless as I am.
Whenever Elis has a spare moment, she holes up inside my Wishing Box, claiming she's close to cracking its secrets.
I even helped Alina crack a major slave-trafficking case. A powerful noble named Caligula had been kidnapping free citizens of Filanis and selling them to other cities.
I'm only aching today because Alina and I dove straight into a bath to hide from those slavers yesterday, before my muscles even had a chance to cool down.
Man, that hits the spot...==W== Her technique feels just like Noya's.
I shake my head to clear the ridiculous thought.
Alina isn't Noya. She doesn't mind me treating her as Noya,==W== but it's still rude of me.
It's been weeks since I woke up in that Wishing Box. I still have no idea how it brought me to Filanis, or how to get back.
Is making a wish at the tower really my only way home?==W== The tower here demands a heavy toll. What would a wish like that cost me?
Noya, Iris, Amber... I wonder how everyone's doing.
Thinking about my friends back home...==W== Wait. What did you just call me?
Boss. You used that title when we raided the slaver carriages. That's what they call you back home, right?
You smiled, but then your eyes looked sad. I figured you were homesick, so I called you Boss... I thought it might help.
Thanks, Alina.==W== But if you call me Boss, that makes you my Dark Knight. That is the title you used when we hit those carriages.
Dark Knight... It sounds so corrupt no matter how many times I hear it. Still... If it means being the Boss's Dark Knight, I don't mind it.
After all, I've grown dependent on your cooking, and I love how we find ways to do what we're supposed to do ... without always playing by the rules.
If that's corruption, you've succeeded. I've gladly given in to it.
Ahem! Elis was just teasing with all that talk about corrupting you, Alina. It wasn't for real.
Tell me, Boss, what makes something ... real?
Back when they called me No. 18 in the arena, I wanted a real name.
The name "Yonon" never felt real to me. It felt like a label for selling oneself. To me, a real name had to be a full name, like those of the spectators in the stands.
Then I got a name like that. Alina Colossi. Some say Alina means light and hope.
Others say it marks my victory in the Grand Arena. "Alina" echoes "arena," the name for the sandy ground at its center.
Either way, having a name like the spectators' ones made me feel...==W== I could become a true knight,==W== a Night Watcher who protects Filanis and repays Archon Olympia.
So I upheld tradition. I did my best at everything I could, and I saved everyone I could reach.
Bringing Elis and me to Filanis, worried we might be runaway slaves...
Investigating the disappearances completely on her own...
Stepping in to save slaves she'd never even met...
Alina really has lived by those principles this whole time. But...
But then Elis told me how Night Watchers in Emor make their money...
And I saw with my own eyes those "knights" of Filanis were kidnapping children. I saw Senate families selling their own people into slavery...
I... I don't know anymore. If I stay on this path, will I ever become a true knight or a true Night Watcher?
... If those people are my future, what's the point of chasing this goal at all?
Then I met you two, got "corrupted," and we actually helped the people who needed it.
But...==W== You aren't a real Acolyte, and Elis threw away her title as a Saintess.==PLAYER_NAME== Why aren't good people like you walking the noble path everyone praises?
What ... am I supposed to do?
Alina's struggling with the exact same doubts I had.
But what if we fail to find proof in a month?
Terrified of dragging everyone down, nearly crushed by fear of the future... Alina hides it well, but she must have been under a lot of pressure to confide in me.
I can't answer that for you, Alina. You remember what I told you about that organization branding me the Tyrant who will destroy the world?
You mentioned it before.==W== Those people are ignorant. If you're a world-destroying Tyrant, what does that make those who abuse slaves and treat people like objects?
I was just as lost as you back then. I couldn't see the road ahead or understand who I was or what was right,==W== until my friends told me...
Anyway, Boss.==W== I heard one of Angie's main reasons for calling you the Tyrant is that you're always helping people, always doing good deeds.
If you're the Tyrant... We're fine with that.
Exactly! The world could use a few more Tyrants like you.
You have wonderful companions, ==PLAYER_NAME==.==W== They're right.
The world==W== could use a few more Tyrants==W== like you.
I don't know what the words "Knight" and "Night Watcher" mean to you.==W== I just want you to know...
Titles don't define people. People define titles.
If your idea of a knight or a Night Watcher doesn't match everyone else's, so be it.
What matters is==W== knowing you chose your own path, and never regretting it.
If you can't figure it all out right away, there's a simple temporary solution.
When you break tradition,==W== just pretend you're someone else.
Angie wants to arrest the Tyrant who will destroy the world.==W== What does that have to do with me, the Boss running a tiny company?
Sure, I'm just fooling myself.==W== But if a little make-believe helps you breathe easier,==W== there's no harm in it.
Someone else...==W== So when I get "corrupted" with you, I'm no longer a Night Watcher of Filanis. I'm the Boss's Dark Knight.==W== Yes, I get it!
Listen up! I am the Dark Knight under Boss's command!==W== Let darkness descend!
That lacks punch...==W== How about this?==W== I am the Dark Knight under Boss's command!==W== Feel the pain!
Hmm, that doesn't feel right either.
I'm trying to come up with a signature line for the Dark Knight.==W== In the epics Lulu reads me,==W== villains always drop a memorable line at the big moment.
That way, nobody mixes up the Dark Knight with the Night Watcher.==W== But my lines were too plain...==W== Got any better ones, Boss?
Alina's really getting into this...==W== Is she actually having fun? Does she have a thing for role-playing?==W== Whatever.==W== If it cheers her up...
A signature line, huh...==W== I remember reading a few of those in the library aboard the Lucky Oasis...
Got it. I read a line in a story of Loongs that fits perfectly.
Born between heaven and earth,==W== how can a true hero bow to another for long?!==W==
Ooh, powerful! Does it express a wild, unstoppable ambition?
Exactly. A peerless general said it originally, and the spirit fits a Dark Knight perfectly.
Agreed! A Dark Knight who's always talking about overthrowing her master would certainly leave an impression!
Born between heaven and earth,==W== how can this knight bow to another for long?!==W==
Whoa, bad idea.==W== Why do I feel like she's going to cut me down any second?
There you are, Captain Alina! I've finished the task you gave me. Oh, ==PLAYER_NAME=='s here too?
Huh? Why are you pressed so close together? Is this some kind of secret meeting?
Ahem! Good work, Lulu. We were indeed discussing something ...==W== very important.
Got it. I read a line in a Goodwind story that fits perfectly.
On the battlefield,==W== honor is a warrior's greatest folly.
Does that mean you should always be ready to switch sides?
Right. A ruler said that of an unconventional tactician.==W== Critics faulted him for switching sides out of pure pragmatism, but he did help that ruler usher in a new era.
I see.==W== You're hinting that I should abandon Archon Olympia and pledge myself to you, Boss.==W== Loud and clear.

I'd love for Alina to be as close to me as the New Star Guild, sure, but I'm not shameless enough to steal her away like that! Wait...==W== If I deny it now, she'll definitely take it the wrong way!==W==
That's right. I'm Boss. I want the finest talent in the world,==W== and I've got my sights set==W== on you!
What a corrupt invitation. Still...==W== I appreciate the offer, and I don't mind you asking.==W== It's just that I still owe Archon Olympia a debt of gratitude.
There you are, Captain Alina! I've finished the task you gave me. Oh, ==PLAYER_NAME=='s here too?
Huh? Why are you pressed so close together? Is this some kind of secret meeting?
Ahem! Good work, Lulu. We were indeed discussing something ...==W== very important.
Got it. I read a line in a lighthearted story that fits perfectly.
Yeah. It's what a proud female knight says when the enemy captures her and she demands an honorable death.
No, no, you need to sound more humiliated.
Close. Try feeling it out yourself.
Yes, yes, that's it!==W== That's exactly what I wanted!
Boss,==W== you aren't taking this seriously at all!==W== You just wanted to hear me say that!
Uh, wait... It isn't like that, Alina. Let me explain!
Didn't you say you were still sore?==W== Let me massage you again.==W== I won't hold back this time!
There you are, Captain Alina! I've finished the task you gave me.==W== Oh,==W== ==PLAYER_NAME=='s here too?
Huh? Why are you pressed so close together? Is this some kind of secret meeting?
Ahem! Good work, Lulu. We were indeed discussing something ...==W== very important.
I understand. What you asked me to investigate is indeed serious. ==PLAYER_NAME=='s helping you too, right?
As we suspected, something was wrong with the people we rescued from that cavern except the three Filanis kids.==W==
Every single one of them was granted a name by Archon Olympia.
